subject: End CODE-CAMERA-RESIZE-20261005: stable tested hashes, final-build input
body:
# CODE-CAMERA-RESIZE-20261005: stable

Scrum authorised this narrow window after ART-POSE-INTEGRATE released. Mailbox and final-build locks checked before claim; no active integration window. Claude begin notice 1791211757711-4d6af05ad2d0. Only MapViewport.jsx, viewport.js, existing ui.test.js and own QA/report changed. No art, core, generator, planner, banks or shared HTML changes. Claude owns the final shared build.

## Change

The map starts with an unmeasured zero size. At its first positive measured size, or when runId identifies a different mission, it receives the existing initial phone Overview or desktop/tablet native camera. Later size changes preserve scale and the world point at the old viewport centre, move that point to the new centre and apply the existing clamp. Same-mission state updates therefore preserve the camera too. Explicit Overview, centre-based zoom buttons/keyboard, manual Find, automatic focus Lock, pointer/wheel handling, hit geometry and all action rules are unchanged.

## Verification

Nine focused existing UI tests pass: geometry, zoom/hit mapping, clamping, action/confirmation resize preservation and reversibility, first-size and mission replacement, edge/small-world clamping, exact private gate and feedback. The test's first clamp assertion initially distinguished negative zero from zero; corrected to numerical coordinate comparison without changing production clamping.

The isolated QA preview rebuilt successfully at 14254418 bytes with stable imported art. This is not WallabyMaths.html or www/index.html. Browser tests use independent generated Unequal Crossing T3 seed2 missions and real route/controller/reducer. At 390x844, 768x1024 and 1280x800, both locked and unlocked: maximum zoom, Find Amberly, Move, click reachable hex1,5, preview, Cancel. All six sequences retain scale2 and the exact centre world point across layout changes. Phone confirmation changes map height307 to300 and back; tablet475 to505 to486 to475; desktop382 to397 to397 to382. All30 DOM measurements have zero commands and byte-identical trace/progress to their sequence baseline; heroes retain2AP. Fresh phone first-size starts0.45, keyboard plus reaches0.5625 around the same centre and explicit Overview returns0.45. Viewport override reset after captures. Physical touch/pinch, Android, child playtesting and final integrated App acceptance are not claimed.

Evidence: camera-resize-postfix-20261005.json, resize-{phone,tablet,desktop}-{unlocked,locked}-{before,move,preview,cancel}.png and each preview.txt. The first phone case intentionally navigated before applying the smaller viewport: it retained initial desktop zoom1 on resize, as the new preservation rule requires. The separate resize-phone-first-usable case applies the phone size before navigation and verifies initial phone fitting.

## Separate visibility defect, unchanged

Read and visually inspected ART's `hero-cobweb-action-phone-maximum-focused.png` in art-pose-integrate-20261005. At phone maximum focus, Cobweb's Holding and health/AP labels occupy the same upper map band as the painted camera buttons and Goal HUD: portions of Holding and health/AP text are covered by these overlays. The hero silhouette remains complete; foreground Hookmole overlaps parts of the lower hero region. This is a selected-hero information visibility defect, separate from camera resizing. No sprite, HUD, label or renderer change in this window. A future explicit HUD-placement window should keep selected-hero health/hold information clear of reserved camera/Goal rectangles and verify it against this real saved-state prefix, rather than changing source alpha or silently broadening this fix.
